description: APPLICATION FOR CHANGE OF USE FROM B2/B8 INDUSTRIAL TO SUI GENERIS FOOD PRODUCTION AND DISTRIBUTION HUB TO INCLUDE NEW EXTENSION TO PROVIDE A RETAIL FACILITY.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: [Drawing no: 229.05/A.06.REV A
Drawing no: 229.05/A.05.REV B
Drawing no: 229.05/A.03.REV C
Drawing Number: Windsor House - Proposed HVAC Side and Rear Elevation Date: 05/06/2025
Drawing no: 229.05/A.01.REV A
]

Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the approved drawings unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Provision of Vehicle Parking - The vehicle parking area including disabled parking space and EV charging point and scooter spaces shown on the approved plans shall be provided before the commencement of the buildings or use hereby permitted and shall be retained for parking purposes for occupiers and users of the development and for no other purpose.

Condition : 5 - Cycle Parking  - Details to be Submitted - The development hereby approved shall not comence first use until details of secure cycle parking facilities for the users of, and visitors to, the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use prior to the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times.

Condition : 6 - Retail - The proposed retail 'butchers retail shop' of the development hereby approved shall not exceed 82 sqm of internal floor space as shown on the approved drawings and shall remain ancillary to the primary food production and distribution use (sui generis) of the site.

Reason: To ensure the retail element remains ancillary and does not result in over intensive retail use that would conflict with the sites employment function and surrounding industrial uses and to comply with Merton Local Plan 2024 policies EC13.2, EC13.4 and TC13.8.

Condition : 7 - Office - The first floor office space shown on the approved plans shall remain in use for office or ancillary employment purposes associated with the food production and distribution hub and shall not be used for residential purposes or separately let for unrelated uses.

Reason: To ensure retention of employment floor space and safeguard the operational function of the site and to comply with Merton Local Plan 2024 policies EC 13.2 and EC 13.4.

Condition : 8 - Noise levels, (expressed as the equivalent continuous sound level) LAeq (15 minutes), from the plant/machinery shall not exceed LA90 minus 10dB at the boundary with the closest residential property.  
Reason: To protect the amenities of neighbouring premises from noise, odour, vibration and environmental disturbance associated with the operation of the site and to comply with Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.3 and EC13.2.

Condition : 9 - The scheme submitted to manage and control the odour from cooking shall be fully installed, maintained and serviced in accordance with the manufacturers' instructions or requirements, whilst the premises is operating. so that it meets the high criteria in the risk assessment within the guidance document 'Control of Odour and Noise from Commercial Kitchen Exhaust Systems' as produced by EMAQ dated 2018.
Reason: To protect the amenities of neighbouring premises from noise, odour, vibration and environmental disturbance associated with the operation of the site and to comply with Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.3 and EC13.2.

Condition : 10 - No obstruction or cowl is to be fitted above the extract opening. Flexible couplings and mountings are to be used between the ductwork and the walls so there is no transmission of vibration.
Reason: To protect the amenities of neighbouring premises from noise, odour, vibration and environmental disturbance associated with the operation of the site and to comply with Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.3 and EC13.2.

Condition : 11 - Stack height should be 1m above roof ridge and not located near any mechanical ventilation intakes on neighbouring buildings.
Reason: To protect the amenities of neighbouring premises from noise, odour, vibration and environmental disturbance associated with the operation of the site and to comply with Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.3 and EC13.2.

Condition : 12 - Drainage serving the kitchen in commercial part of the premises shall be fitted with an adequate grease separator.
Reason: To protect the amenities of neighbouring premises from noise, odour, vibration and environmental disturbance associated with the operation of the site and to comply with Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.3 and EC13.2.

Condition : 13 - No development shall take place until a Demolition and Construction Method Statement is approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The approved Statement shall be adhered to throughout the demolition and construction period. 
The Statement shall provide for:
"	hours of operation
"	the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors 
"	loading and unloading of plant and materials 
"	storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development 
"	the erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative -displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate 
"	wheel washing facilities 
"	measures to control the emission of noise and vibration during construction.
"	measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction/demolition 
"	a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction work
"	Delivery times
"	Control of surface water run-off.

Reason: To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and ensure the demolition and construction works are carried out safely, and to comply with Merton Local Plan 2024 policy D12.3.

Any such works or events commissioned by the developer and particularly those involving the connection of any utility to the site, shall be co-ordinated by them in liaison with the London Borough of Merton, Network Coordinator, (telephone 020 8545 3976).
